notes: Pointer steps: zrender Handler mousemove / mousedown + mouseup + click / mouseout from outside the canvas; each 10 ms after the last; a frame of every chart after every step.
TooltipRichContent.getSize answers 80 x 40; box is the moveTo argument.

cases.note: an item tooltip: grid 0 writes a formatter of its own, which the cascade [item, series, coordinate system] reaches before the global one; grid 1 does not; a series formatter over the grid's
the series' own formatter wins over its grid's

a global item trigger, grid 0 says trigger axis: grid 0 collects its tooltip axes (the pointer and an axis tooltip there), and an item over grid 0's bar shows nothing of its own (its cascade says axis); grid 1 stays item
a global axis trigger, grid 1 asks for a cross through its tooltip.axisPointer: both of its axes show, with labels; grid 0 keeps a line on its base axis
the grid's tooltip.axisPointer.type shadow is one of the fields its axes take
grid 1 says tooltip.show false: no tooltip axes there (no pointer, no box); its item cascade says show false as well
a global item trigger and polar.tooltip.trigger axis: the polar's angle axis takes the pointer
a scatter on a single axis: singleAxis.tooltip formatter for its items
a calendar has no model on its coordinate system (Calendar._model): calendar.tooltip is not in the cascade

showTip with payload.tooltip at x / y: a proxy element carrying it as a component tooltip -- a string (content and formatter), an object with a formatter, an object with content only (its content is the formatter level), an object with neither (the global formatter), a position from the option; without x / y it falls to the next branch

updateAxisPointer with a tooltipOption: it rides into the showTip and is the top level of the axis tooltip's model (its formatter over the global one; showContent false shows nothing); a showTip with dataByCoordSys and one

guards.what: the series formatter over its grid one
the polar axis tooltip (its formatter is not the axis tooltip one)
showContent false: the content is not touched, the last one stays
